facts: The empty-request fast path was present in this 530-file snapshot. The run reached native code and stopped on EXC_BREAKPOINT after about 982 seconds.
The trap is relativeAddress+4432, the numeric success-tag check after an allocation callback. The callback completed normally (x0=1); the caller loaded a zero presence tag into x9 and trapped.
The additional LLDB memory-read command used an incompatible display format, so allocation-vector contents were not captured. No stage2 image was written.
The configured 3 GiB managed mapping is split into two 1.5 GiB semispaces, each with a 256 MiB nursery and 1.25 GiB old region. This is a capacity fact, not proof that live data exhausted it.
